_doc: Metric registry. Every metric names the exact Phase 1 function in lib/dsp/measure/* it reads, the unit of the value, the unit of a DELTA, and its precise definition. 'extract' is declarative: adding a metric of an existing kind needs no TypeScript. Third-octave bands are matched by NOMINAL centre (IEC 61260 base-10 centres, 2% tolerance): 250 -> 251 Hz, 3150 -> 3162 Hz, 4000 -> 3981 Hz, 5000 -> 5012 Hz, 6300 -> 6310 Hz, 8000 -> 7943 Hz.

metrics.label: Integrated loudness
metrics.definition: ITU-R BS.1770-4 integrated loudness of the whole file (result field 'integrated'). A delta of +3 LU means 3 LU louder than the reference median.

metrics.label: Loudness range
metrics.definition: EBU Tech 3342 loudness range (P95 - P10 of gated 3 s short-term loudness), result field 'lra'.

metrics.label: True peak
metrics.definition: Highest 4x-oversampled peak across channels, result field 'truePeak'.

metrics.label: Crest factor (active audio)
metrics.definition: Peak over RMS (dB) restricted to 100 ms blocks above the activity floor, result field 'activeCrest'. Lower = more compressed.

metrics.label: Boxiness (250 Hz band)
metrics.definition: Level of the 250 Hz third-octave band (223-281 Hz) minus the file's total level. Level-independent spectral shape: positive delta = more boxy than the reference.

metrics.label: Presence (about 3.5 kHz)
metrics.definition: Power sum of the 3150 Hz and 4000 Hz third-octave bands (2.8-4.5 kHz, which straddle 3.5 kHz because no third-octave band is centred on 3.5 kHz) minus the file's total level. Positive delta = more presence than the reference.

metrics.label: Sibilance (5-9 kHz)
metrics.definition: Power sum of the 5000, 6300 and 8000 Hz third-octave bands (4.5-8.9 kHz, the closest whole-band cover of 5-9 kHz) minus the file's total level. Positive delta = harsher 's' energy than the reference.

metrics.label: Noise floor
metrics.definition: RMS of the validated noise print (DC removed), result field 'noiseFloor'. Unavailable without a valid noise print. Positive delta = noisier than the reference.

metrics.label: Clipped samples
metrics.definition: Samples inside flat-top clipping runs (result field 'clippedSamples') divided by all samples across channels. 0 = none.

metrics.label: Plosive pops
metrics.definition: Number of low-frequency pop events (result field 'eventCount') per minute of audio. Phase 1 plosive detector, default placeholder thresholds.
